evals.name: open-pick
evals.prompt: Připrav jeden instagramový post o té nejlepší novince v reISu, o které jsme ještě nic nepostovali.
evals.expected_output: One rendered post about a student-facing feature not in posted.json, with caption, alt text and a passing rating.
assertions: feature PRs are not in posted.json

evals.name: classmates
evals.prompt: Udělej post o spolužácích – že teď uvidíš celý předmět, ne jen svoje cvičení.
evals.expected_output: A post about Spolužáci / Celý předmět (#490, #505) whose phone shows the classmates list with fictional names.

evals.name: exam-legend
evals.prompt: make an IG post about the exam term legend in Zkoušky (PR 483)
evals.expected_output: Either a passing post about the exam term legend or a reasoned decision that it is too small to post.
assertions: either a 1080x1350 post.jpg with a passing rating, or notes.md explains why it is not worth a post
independent rater agrees with the decision
